notes.title: Patch 1.70
notes.notes:
Patch 1.70 has been published.
Changes:
* Trees again can be used to destroy enemies.
* Checkbox to disable notification to friends is restored.
* Island Editor is now available on Mac too.
* Other minor changes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.5 is here! Editor coming soon.
notes.notes:
It took longer than expected but here we are! Update 1.5 is live, you can find the list of fixed stuff below, but first, completely new look! Check it out: 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/839e77d19e1e324efe16b464e294d9d4beb7d248.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/b3b3959712bb73417a7ec42d547a4fd580023c34.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/5dd2dfaec3689873d02535d66775150569716eb7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/7425085ca1b97d01736b6703fb0dabbe2108744e.jpg[/img]

What else:

* Fix for resolution settings 
* Fix for wrong total score calculation on island 9 
* Fix for some Linux system, where the game was crashing 
* Fix for people with one button mouse, who unable to start multiplayer, you can press "M" key to open multiplayer panel.

Let us know what do you think about this update on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/337270/discussions/0/358415206092708815/] game forum [/url]! 

[b]Next update will bring in-game editor![/b] Want to create own islands? Stay tuned!

notes.title: New big update coming in May!
notes.notes:
[img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/oi2016Spring_small.jpg]

Sorry for the lack of news recently. Unfortunately we don't have enough resources to work on Ostrich Island as much as we want, but updates and fixes will keep coming. Above is a small glimpse of Ostrich Island new look, which will come in May. You may expect:
* New look and feel
* Fix for resolution settings
* Fix for wrong total score calculation on island 9
* Fix for some Linux system, where the game is crashing
* Fix for people with one button mouse, who unable to start multiplayer.

You could also preview the Full HD image here: http://i.imgur.com/qOUi578.png

notes.title: Small update here
notes.notes:
A small Ostrich Island update is set live on Steam, here what's new: 
[list]
[*] Improved visuals, added more details to the ground and some stuff on horizon.
[*] Friend's notifications turned off by default.
[*] No need to click on map anymore to start the game.
[*] Other tiny improvements.
[/list]

Have fun and let's discuss on forum what you like/dislike in this update.

notes.title: Co-op changes, Game+ improvements and more.
notes.notes:
New update is available for your dear ostriches!
What's new:
[list]
[*]When switching back from Game+ to normal difficulty all islands will be unlocked again.
[*]Co-op. Progress calculation changed, now it is possible to reach 100% playing together with a friend.
[*]Co-op. Added counter how many games played and won.
[*]Improved lights on Level 8 and 9, increasing performance.
[*]Added possibility to send message to friends when passing their score.
[/list]

More features coming soon, stay tuned!

notes.title: Ostrich Island update has been released.
notes.notes:
What's new:
- Fixed problem with equipping hats. 
- Fixed Game+ mode, hidden islands are unlockable in Game+ again.
+ Added possibility to switch back to Normal difficulty when Game+ started.
+ Added possibility to invert camera Y
- Decreased one enemy speed on Silent Krill island.
- Other minor fixes
